minutes.headline: Committee backed a developer's bus shelter, named the superintendent search committee, and weighed blizzard bags.
minutes.summary: The committee heard a developer present a bus shelter and sidewalk at a new development, then heard students report on a conference. It discussed blizzard bags for snow days with the principals and made search-committee appointments. It took motions on the bus shelter, the superintendent and principal search appointments, and one line-item transfer.

public_comment.topic: A PTO representative thanked principals, the superintendent and staff who answered PTO questions on health and security.
A teacher praised the mock trial program and its students, and thanked the committee for its support.
A resident asked about selection criteria for the superintendent screening committee and about parent representation.

votes.motion: Approve one line item transfer at Turkey Hill from general supplies to science supplies (recommendation to approve)
Support the school bus waiting area shelter location per the design presented
Appoint the superintendent screening committee members as listed
Appoint Mr. Levesque to the principal search committee
Approve the superintendent screening committee with changes

budget_items.topic: Line item transfer, Turkey Hill general supplies to science supplies
budget_items.what_was_said: A transfer was brought to buy consumable fifth grade science unit supplies.
The conference fee covers meals and hotels; cost and missed school were the two barriers to sending more students.
Students reported the amount raised, short of one full wish.
The Wellness Committee is raising funds for a service. The district would seek outside donations for two years to allow budget planning.

transfers.description: From Turkey Hill general school supplies to science supplies

decisions.decision: Blizzard bag exploration to go to the policy subcommittee and be discussed at a later meeting; a charge for any subcommittee to be drafted first.
The snack shack policies and procedures will go to the policy subcommittee as a draft.
Superintendent search committee update and principal search update placed on a future agenda.

what_happened.line: The committee took motions to support a developer's school bus shelter location and to appoint the superintendent screening committee; vote results were not audible.
Motions also covered the principal search committee appointment and a later superintendent screening committee approval with changes; outcomes were not audible.
The committee discussed blizzard bags for snow days; the idea goes to the policy subcommittee after a charge is drafted.
A line item transfer at Turkey Hill, from general supplies to science supplies, was put to a vote at the start of the meeting; the outcome was not audible.
The snack shack policies and procedures go to the policy subcommittee as a draft.

why_it_matters: The superintendent and principal searches decide who leads the district's schools, and a resident asked at the meeting how members were chosen and whether parents are represented.
Blizzard bags could change how snow days are made up, which touches the school calendar for families, though no decision has been made.
